forbiddenInputs: similarity to Candidate 1's Historical V5 failures as a selection preference

requirements.coachNote: coach identity is carried by the fixture spec rather than the player store, and is joined here on the canonical team-season key. Where the spec row exists, the coach must also have been verified as named on that season's own Wikipedia page at store-build time. A team-season with no resolvable, verified coach cannot be selected.

nearOverlapRules.fiveOfFive: EXCLUDE — the same five people is the same lineup whatever the ids say
nearOverlapRules.fourOfFive: EXCLUDE — one substitution away from a seen lineup is a proxy for it
nearOverlapRules.threeOfFive: ALLOW, recorded — three shared people out of five is a different team
nearOverlapRules.aliasSameTeamSeason: EXCLUDE — normalised by canonical team and season, so an alias cannot slip through
nearOverlapRules.sameFiveDifferentSlots: EXCLUDE — lineup identity is the unordered person set, not the slot assignment
nearOverlapRules.sameTeamAndCoachSeasonTrivialDifference: EXCLUDE at 4/5 or above; below that the roster genuinely differs
nearOverlapRules.canonicalPersonOverlap: every comparison is made on canonical person ids, not card or calibration-player ids, so a person appearing under two ids cannot disguise an overlap

data.universeNote: the corpus and the prior holdout manifests supply the exclusion set; the calibration player stores supply the candidates. A universe of consumed team-seasons alone yields 0 eligible, which is what the corrected policy returned before the stores were read.

priorPhaseDefectCorrected.what: Phase 6C4C1's pool added the calibration and Historical V3 exclusion lists as raw fixture ids while keying candidate rows as team-name-and-season, so neither exclusion could ever match.
priorPhaseDefectCorrected.consequence: 24 calibration team-seasons and 8 consumed Historical V3 team-seasons remained in that pool. Its first eligible row was h3-1956-57-celtics, a calibration corpus team.
priorPhaseDefectCorrected.correction: every id is normalised to a canonical team-and-season key, and every lineup comparison is made on canonical person ids.
priorPhaseDefectCorrected.alsoAdded: near-overlap protection at 5/5 and 4/5, era-reference and Candidate 2 control-fixture lineups, and a resolvable-coach requirement.

normalisation.teamSeasonKey: lowercased team name and season with non-alphanumerics stripped
normalisation.lineupKey: the sorted, de-duplicated set of canonical person ids
normalisation.personResolution: calibration-player ids resolve to their person segment; public card ids resolve through the person store
